theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U N E : Set (Euclid P)) (ξN : Euclid P → MultiVector P (n + 1)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (x : Euclid P), 1 ≤ n → IsOpen U → InClassO n U N ξN → MeasurableSet E → E ⊆ N ∩ U → IsBoundaryOfRegion T E ξN → IsIntegerMultiplicity T → x ∈ N ∩ U → ∃ (Z₀ M' : Set (Euclid P)) (ξ' : Euclid P → MultiVector P n), IsOpen Z₀ ∧ x ∈ Z₀ ∧ Z₀ ⊆ U ∧ MeasurableSet M' ∧ M' ⊆ Z₀ ∧ CountablyRectifiable n M' ∧ μHE[n] M' ≠ ∞ ∧ AEStronglyMeasurable ξ' (μHE[n].restrict M') ∧ (∀ᵐ w ∂(μHE[n].restrict M'), ∃ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), IsUnitOrientationOf (ξ' w) Q) ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) ⊆ Z₀ → T ω = ∫ w in M', ξ' w ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) w) ∂μHE[n]
